fusions.name: First Notice
fusions.desc: Fires a bolt that hits the first enemy in its path for 4 damage, with 30% more critical chance against a target that has not yet been wounded.

fusions.name: Startled Kick
fusions.desc: You lash out, dealing 11 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles and knocking them back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Bounding Leap
fusions.desc: Bounds 4 tiles forward, and your movement speed rises by 20% for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Already Gone
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a blow you failed to dodge rolls your dodge a second time, and the second roll stands.
